description: How much will this cost and how long will it take? Free and needs no account. Estimate how many credits a thermal, CFD or meshing run will use and how long it will take, before running it. Use before create_mesh or run_simulation, and to compare options; give the planned cell count (or an owned mesh_artifact_id) and solver steps. Signed in, it also says whether your plan, credits and key budget would admit the run. For explicitly authorized automatic mesh retries, set mesh_max_attempts to the same total attempt budget as the mesh request so the upper time estimate covers it. Read-only: no inputs are uploaded and no compute starts. Meshes are charged by delivered cells (failed meshes and automatic rebuilds are free), predictions per success, simulations by measured compute; the high value is held.

inputSchema.description: What you plan to run; no inputs are uploaded and no compute starts.

architecture.description: Fluxcore GPU solver. Use 'fluxcore'; 'workhorse' remains an accepted compatibility identifier for saved requests and deployed workers.

cells.description: Mesh target cells (operation=mesh) or the simulation mesh's cell count. Defaults to 1 million for meshes; for simulations supply cells or mesh_artifact_id.

gpu.description: Simulation GPU type: B200 (default) or H100.

mesh_artifact_id.description: Owned mesh whose verified cell count to use (signed-in callers only).

mesh_max_attempts.description: Total authorized full mesh attempts, for the upper time estimate. Use 1 for retry_policy=review; for automatic, copy max_remesh_iterations (octree/OpenFOAM) or max_target_iterations (structured). Read-only estimation does not authorize a retry. Automatic rebuilds are not charged: a mesh costs the same credits however many attempts it takes.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate cost and time
